articles.title: A Russian stablecoin built to dodge sanctions says it can survive even if they're lifted
articles.snippet: A7A5, the Russia-linked stablecoin built to move money around banking restrictions, says faster trade settlement, yield and regional crypto infrastructure could keep it relevant even if geopolitical tensions ease.

articles.title: U.S. House lawmakers who oversee the CFTC are urging Trump to fill the commission
articles.snippet: As the Commodity Futures Trading Commission takes on a growing task to police U.S. crypto trading, senior lawmakers are saying it needs bipartisan leadership.

articles.title: Polish lawmakers back revised crypto bill after repeated vetoes
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers approve a Ministry of Finance-backed crypto bill to implement the EU MiCA framework in a 241–200 vote after repeated vetoes.

articles.title: Hyperliquid Policy Arm Rejects Market Integrity Concerns Amid Oil Futures Surge
articles.snippet: Decentralized exchange Hyperliquid has become a popular destination for speculating on oil prices.
